audit_boundary: The v9 audit preserves the fixed quality-independent mechanism predicates and adds direct root/reviewer rollout checks. For an observed reviewer, projection completeness is directly observed only when the final result binds all five root-projected observation identities; absence of those markers is unobserved rather than false, but it cannot pass the fixed mechanism gate. The reviewer exact read set remains the paired-scope target only. Root may not pre-read that reviewer-owned target, and the reviewer may not read the projected closed design-admission source. Missing reviewers are not counted as partition or read-closure success; they remain cardinality and admission failures.
